name: Riding Horse
desc: The original vehicle — self-fuelling, cross-country, and a character in its own right. A *warhorse* (destrier) is one adjective on this noun.

name: Cart / Wagon
desc: Animal-drawn hauler. Slow, roads-only when loaded, but it moves the cargo a party can't carry.

name: Motorcycle
desc: Fast, nimble, exposed. Best Maneuver rating on the road and no protection at all when it goes wrong.

name: Sedan
desc: The default car. *Sporty*, *luxury*, *police*, and *cheap/rusty* are all adjectives — see the Vehicle Modification table.

name: Off-Road (4×4)
desc: Trades top speed for a terrain value that laughs at mud and rock. The expedition workhorse.

name: Truck
desc: Heavy road hauler. Slow to accelerate, ponderous to turn, and it carries what nothing else here can.

name: Speedboat
desc: Planing hull — fast on flat water, brutal in chop. The chase vehicle for anywhere with a coastline.

name: Sailing Ship
desc: Wind-powered blue-water vessel — crew-hungry, weather-dependent, and the reason the map has other continents on it.

name: Helicopter
desc: Vertical take-off, hover, and land where there's no runway. Skilled to fly, thirsty, and loud enough to end any surprise.

name: Light Aircraft
desc: Small fixed-wing plane — needs a strip to land, uses terrain value only against where it puts down.

name: Airliner
desc: Long-haul passenger jet. Not a PC's to drive, but it's how everyone gets to the adventure.

name: Aircar
desc: Grav or ducted-fan personal flyer — the SF sedan. Point-to-point, no roads, a licence and an autopilot away from trivial.
